title: 第100章 封赏第99章 又见御尸术
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
第一卷第100章封赏
数日后，雁门关大营内。
关将军高坐案首，李毅、宋杰等军中将领皆静候在中军大营内，齐齐望向关将军。
只见关将军面前的案桌上，摆放着一卷卷文书，这些都是朝廷送来的封赏书册。
在众人的注视中，关将军取出一张张的文书，将此次封赏宣读。
随着一份份文书被分发下去，营帐内众军官皆是露出了欣喜之意。
李毅站在众人之首，默默看着关将军念诵文书。
作为此战功劳最卓著者，李毅深知此次定然会有极为丰厚的赏赐。
但他最为期望的，便是能够成功晋升为将军。
一份份文书发下，就连李毅麾下的韩甲、刘野等人也皆得到了诸多赏赐，甚至获得了爵位。
终于，关将军面前的文书仅剩下了一份，众人也将目光放在了李毅身上。
在众人期待的目光中，关将军将文书取下，念道：“李毅。”
李毅闻言，快步上前，静静说道：
“属下在。”
只见关将军举着文书，一字一句念道：
“你在此战中，护秋风关有功，又深入敌后，击破宣城，斩杀主将破敌无数，掠夺粮草金银无算，随后又在决战中击杀匈奴左贤王呼韩、灵兽狼王、黑风门长老以及七个青国真气境武将，率军累计斩首青国大军四万人，军功卓著。
特升爵右更，赐良田千亩、金三千两、奴隶一千、食邑两千户。”
李毅本就有封爵第十二等的左更，如今这一战让他连升两爵，获得了第十四等的右更爵位。
顿了顿，关将军继续念道：“转战千里，进退有度，杀敌数万，实力强劲，故升李毅为封号将军，赐封号风虎将军。”
听着这话，李毅顿时一喜，心中的大石头也落了下去。

封号将军乃是偏将军之上的职位，属于正将军序列，关将军此前便是这一职位。
在众人的注视下，李毅缓缓上前，从关将军手中将封赏文书接下，朗声道：“多谢将军，多谢朝廷信任。”
一番客套后，李毅便将文书收下。
经此一战，他不仅成功升爵被封为封号将军，更是获得了大量的资源辎重。
而在成为风虎将军后，其麾下直属的风虎营可扩军为五千，至于破虏营则增兵为三千，除此之外，李毅可再次组建一支人数不超过两千的直属部队。
自此，李毅麾下直属精锐战兵便有一万人。
将文书交给李毅后，关将军继续道：“如今青国已彻底被击垮，数年内无力再犯。
我也得到了调令，即将前往另一处战场，以后李毅你便是雁门关主将了。”
“雁门关主将？”
众人皆是一愣，随即便连连开口祝贺。
听着关将军所言，李毅抱拳上前，郑重道：
“请将军放心，属下一定将雁门关守住，绝不让敌国进犯我陈国土地一丝一毫。”
封赏结束后，大营内充满了欢喜与轻松的氛围。
关将军哈哈一笑，伸手拍了拍李毅，说道：“不必紧张，你的事迹朝廷中皆有听闻，大将军更是对你赞不绝口。
你若有什么需求，尽可开口，大将军定会全力支持你。”
“多谢大将军。”闻言，李毅连忙道谢。
“当然，我能升职也是承了你的情，以后若有需要，尽管向我来信便是。”
关将军将一些心得告诉了李毅，又协助他接手雁门关地区诸多事宜。
如今李毅身为雁门关主将，关将军要去另一处值守，而雁门关诸多军官中，宋杰等人皆是关将军的嫡系，自然要跟着远赴他地。
接下来的一段日子里，关将军都在带着李毅接手诸多事宜。

在其指点下，李毅很快上手，并对未来的雁门关划分有了更多的想法。

Volume 1 Chapter 100 Rewards
A few days later, inside the Yanmen Pass camp.
General Guan sat at the head of the case. Li Yi, Song Jie and other lieutenant generals were waiting quietly in the Chinese army camp, all looking at General Guan.
I saw volumes of documents placed on the desk in front of General Guan. These were all reward books sent by the imperial court.
Under the gaze of everyone, General Guan took out the documents one by one and read out the award.
As documents were distributed one after another, all the officers in the camp showed joy.
Li Yi stood at the head of the crowd, silently watching General Guan recite the document.
As the person with the most outstanding achievements in this battle, Li Yi knew that there would be extremely generous rewards this time.
But what he hopes for most is to be successfully promoted to general.
Documents were issued one after another, and even Han Jia, Liu Ye and others under Li Yi received many rewards and even received titles.
Finally, there was only one document left in front of General Guan, and everyone also focused on Li Yi.
Under the expectant eyes of everyone, General Guan took down the document and read: "Li Yi."
Hearing this, Li Yi stepped forward quickly and said quietly:
"My subordinate is here."
I saw General Guan holding up the document and reading word by word:
"In this battle, you made great achievements in protecting the Qiufeng Pass. You also went deep behind enemy lines, defeated Xuancheng, killed countless generals, and plundered grain, grass, gold and silver. Then in the decisive battle, you killed Huhan, the Xiongnu Zuoxian King, the Spirit Beast Wolf King, the Black Wind Sect elders, and seven Qing Kingdom True Qi Realm generals. You led your army to behead a total of 40,000 Qing Kingdom troops. You have outstanding military exploits.
He was given a special promotion and was given a thousand acres of fertile land, three thousand taels of gold, one thousand slaves, and two thousand households with food. "
Li Yi originally had the twelfth-level knighthood of Zuo Geng, but now this battle allowed him to be promoted to two knights in a row and obtain the fourteenth-level title of Right Geng.
After a pause, General Guan continued to read: "Fighting thousands of miles, advancing and retreating in a controlled manner, killing tens of thousands of enemies, and strong in strength, Li Yi was promoted to the title of General and given the title of General Fenghu."
Hearing this, Li Yi suddenly felt happy, and the big stone in his heart fell.
Titled general is a position above partial general and belongs to the rank of full general. General Guan held this position before.
Under the gaze of everyone, Li Yi slowly stepped forward, took the reward document from General Guan, and said loudly: "Thank you, general, and thank the court for your trust."
After some courtesy, Li Yi accepted the document.
After this battle, he not only succeeded in being promoted to the title of general, but also gained a large amount of resources and equipment.
After becoming General Fenghu, the Fenghu Camp directly under his command can be expanded to 5,000 troops, and the Polu Camp can be increased to 3,000 troops. In addition, Li Yi can once again form a direct troops with no more than 2,000 troops.
Since then, Li Yi has had 10,000 elite soldiers directly under his command.
After handing the document to Li Yi, General Guan continued: “Now the Qing Kingdom has been completely defeated and will be unable to commit another crime within a few years.
I have also received the transfer order and am about to go to another battlefield. From now on, Li Yi, you will be the commander-in-chief of Yanmen Pass. "
"General of Yanmen Pass?"
Everyone was stunned for a moment, and then congratulated him one after another.
After listening to what General Guan said, Li Yi stepped forward with his fists clasped and said solemnly:
"Please rest assured, general, my subordinates will definitely guard Yanmen Pass and never allow the enemy to invade our Chen country's land."
After the awards were given, the camp was filled with a joyful and relaxed atmosphere.
General Guan laughed, reached out and patted Li Yi, and said, "Don't be nervous, everyone in the court has heard about your deeds, and the general is full of praise for you.
If you have any needs, just ask and the general will fully support you. "
"Thank you, General." Hearing this, Li Yi quickly thanked him.
"Of course, I was promoted because of your kindness. If you need it in the future, just write to me."
General Guan told Li Yi some of his experiences and assisted him in taking over many matters in the Yanmenguan area.
Now that Li Yi is the commander-in-chief of Yanmen Pass, General Guan has to go to another place for duty.Among the many officers at Yanmen Pass, Song Jie and others were all direct descendants of General Guan, so they naturally had to follow him to other places.
In the following days, General Guan took Li Yi to take over many matters.
Under his guidance, Li Yi quickly got started and had more ideas about the future division of Yanmen Pass.
